newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on hedges, Dreyfus buys wheat.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on hedges, Dreyfus buys wheat.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on hedge pressure while wheat values finished higher on demand by Louis Dreyfus Corp, traders said.

"Late hedges pushed the canola down," a trader said. "Our rally was overdone," a trader said. Jan-Mar spread at $0.80, Jan-May even money. January futures crush margin rose to -38.76 from -40.63 Thursday on January soyoil, meal. Volume was 5,248 lots, 104,960 tonnes, 385 hedges.
January canola fell $1.70 to $404.70 and March lost $1.20 to $405.60. January flax fell $2.70 at $353.20 on hedges, Nov '97 flax legged at $33.50 to Nov '97 canola, July-Sep $13.
December feed wheat rose $1 to $167, March was unchanged at $168.70 and May was up $0.20 to $168.50 as Louis Dreyfus Corp bought, traders said. Dec-Mar spread at $1.
February western barley lost $0.90 to $139.10, May lost $1.30 to $139.20 on hedges, commercial scale down demand, Alberta Wheat Pool sold February, traders said.
Oats and peas did not trade.
(All values traded in Canadian dollars per tonne except peas, oats).
